en: Colorized city view over the Ljubljanica River toward a central square. A stone bridge crosses the river and a pink Baroque church with twin towers (Franciscan Church of the Annunciation) stands on the left. Ornate late‑19th‑century buildings line the right bank (including the Kresija building). People and carriages are visible. Bilingual caption on the front reads in Slovene and German, and the divided back shows a library stamp.
